sections.title: 1. T6 — Expected Date vs. Actual Date
sections.html:
• What was expected: In the first round and the previous round, the expected-date field of T6 listed the oral argument date (2026-11-03) alongside 'ruling date undetermined' (Source: state.triggers_next_12m T6, Section 5 of the previous round).
  • Actual: On 2026-11-03 (Tue), oral argument was held at the Oregon Supreme Court in Salem. Theodore J. Boutrous Jr. appeared for PacifiCorp and Nicholas Rosinia for the victims (Source: OPB 2026-11-05). The 10-Q (posted on EDGAR 2026-11-09) also states "oral argument was held on November 3, 2026" (Source: 10-Q R31).
  • Two errors (honest record): ① The previous round rendered the 10-Q as 'stated as oral argument scheduled' — the original said 'was held' (a misreading, Source: 10-Q R31). ② The ruling trigger's expected-date field listed the date of an intermediate event that would pass, so the measurement layer woke the engine on the argument date rather than a ruling. This round's event is itself a product of that design mistake.
  • Fix to the expectation method: The expected-date field of a ruling trigger will contain only one ruling checkpoint date. New checkpoint = 2027-05-03 (estimate: oral argument + 6 months. The only basis is the report's 'within months', so the date was not set from court processing-time statistics — it is a checkpoint, not a prediction). The argument date has been moved to the trigger name and verification method fields.

sections.title: 2. 구두변론에서 확인된 것 — 판단 재료(판결 예측 아님)

쟁점(출처: OPB · KLCC, 둘 다 2026-11-05):

  • 1단계 배심 지시('증거가 모든 집단 구성원에게 적용된다고 가정해도 된다')가 배심원을 혼동시켰는가 — 항소법원(2026-04)이 1단계 평결을 파기한 근거(출처: 10-Q R31).
  • 서로 다른 화재 4건(Santiam Canyon·Chiloquin·Lincoln City·Eagle Point)을 한 집단소송으로 묶을 수 있는가.
  • 보도된 법정 분위기: 여러 대법관이 '혼동' 주장에 회의적이었고, 화재마다 별도 질문·별도 평결 양식을 썼다는 점을 짚었다. Bronson James 대법관은 PacifiCorp 가 수정 지시를 스스로 요청했다는 점을 물었다(같은 출처). 법정 분위기는 판결이 아니다 — 이 탐사는 이것으로 확률을 움직이지 않는다(규칙 밖 조정 금지, prompts/monthly_run.md 2항).

판결이 E-2028-1 에 주는 의미(판단 — 숫자는 위 표):

  • 평결 복원(항소법원 판결 파기) 쪽: 정지된 2단계 재판이 재개되고, 평결 1인당 평균 약 $622만(산식 1,250 ÷ 201, 백만 달러)이 약 2,000건(보도치)의 청구에 같은 틀로 적용될 위험이 다시 열린다. 단순 곱은 약 $124억(산식 6.22 × 2,000)이지만 현실적 결과의 추정이 아니다 — 합의 할인·청구별 손해 차이·보험이 빠진 크기 감각용(추정). 누적 인식액 $28.5억에서 $50억(E-2028-1 기준)까지의 여유는 $21.5억이다(산식 50 − 28.5).
  • 항소법원 판결 유지 쪽: 1단계 평결이 사라져 집단 단위 책임 인정이 다시 재판으로 돌아간다 — 신규 손실 인식이 미뤄지는 쪽(판단).
  • 회사는 추가 손실을 '합리적으로 가능하지만 추정 불가'로 공시하고 있다(출처: 10-Q R31) — 판결 전에는 인식액 숫자가 움직일 근거가 없다.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.html:
• One-sentence conclusion: The James case oral argument was held as scheduled on 2026-11-03 and no ruling has been issued yet, so E-2028-1 (cumulative loss $2.85 billion, threshold $5 billion or less) and the 25/50/25 probabilities are unchanged — the real gain from this round is fixing a date-design error in the ruling trigger (source: 10-Q R31 · Section 1).
  • Five-line briefing
  • Oregon Supreme Court held oral argument in the James case on 2026-11-03; a written ruling is expected 'within months' (OPB 2026-11-05).
  • At stake: cumulative Phase 2 verdicts of about $1.25 billion (201 people), about 2,000 additional claims (reported), and the remaining damages trials on hold (10-Q R31).
  • The issues are whether the Phase 1 jury instructions were confusing and whether class-action eligibility applies to the four fires — reports of the mood in the courtroom are not used in the assessment (KLCC).
  • Correction to the previous round: the 10-Q stated the argument as 'held,' not 'scheduled' · Class B shares closed at $575.25 on 11/9 (previous value $574.76, stockanalysis).
  • The T6 expected date was replaced with the ruling checkpoint of 2027-05-03 (estimated) — so that intermediate event dates passing by do not wake the engine again (Section 1).
  • Three data points to check directly before the next round
  • 3Q26 13F (2026-11-16; formula: quarter-end + 45 days = 11-14 Saturday → next business day) — security-by-security details of 3Q buys and sells (T1).
  • Final prospectus for the yen bond — total issuance vs. the refinancing target of ¥96.4 billion (formula 734 + 230, 424B5) (T8).
  • Oregon Supreme Court ruling notice — if the verdict is reinstated, E-2028-1 and R5 will be re-measured in that round (T6).
